item.title: Qatar and US discuss expanding trade that topped $7.05bn
item.description:
Qatar and the United States held a high-level economic session on trade and investment in Washington under the eighth Qatar-US Strategic Dialogue. It was co-chaired by HE Minister of State for Foreign Trade Affairs Dr Ahmed bin Mohammed Al Sayed and US Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth Jacob Helberg. Al Sayed said bilateral trade exceeded $7.05bn in 2025, up 11.4%, and that more than 1,000 US companies operate in Qatar. The session focused on advanced technology, artificial intelligence and supply-chain security.
Sources: QNA https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qatar-us-stress-importance-of-advancing-economic-partnership · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-us-stress-importance-of-advancing-economic-partnership · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266475/front/qatar-us-seek-to-advance-economic-ties

item.title: Al Misnad chairs Qatar-Canada humanitarian working group in Ottawa
item.description:
HE Minister of State for International Cooperation Dr Maryam bint Ali bin Nasser Al Misnad chaired in Ottawa the meeting of the Qatar-Canada working group on development and humanitarian cooperation, on the sidelines of the first strategic dialogue between the two countries. The meeting covered humanitarian and development work in Syria and the Gaza Strip, the continuity of essential services and linking humanitarian response with early recovery. The minister also met Canadian Secretary of State for International Development Randeep Sarai.
Sources: Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266422/latest-news/al-misnad-chairs-meeting-of-qatar-canada-working-group-on-development-humanitarian-cooperation · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739037/qatar/al-misnad-meets-canadas-secretary-of-state-for-international-development

item.title: 130 inclusive schools serve 4,220 students with disabilities
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education held the second Inclusion and Empowerment Forum on Wednesday, ahead of the International Day of Persons with Disabilities on 3 December. The ministry said the number of inclusive schools has reached 130 this academic year, serving 4,220 students with disabilities. Director of Special Education and Inclusive Education Amna Al Mulla said genuine inclusion requires education that responds to each student's needs.
Sources: QNA https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/inclusion-forum-highlights-efforts-to-improve-education-for-students-with-disabilities · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/130-مدرسة-للدمج-تحتضن-4220-طالبا-وطالبة

item.title: Ihsan Centre wins three-year CARF international accreditation
item.description:
Ihsan, the Centre for Empowerment and Elderly Care under the Qatar Foundation for Social Work, has received CARF International accreditation for three years, until 31 October 2029. The accreditation report contained no recommendations for improvement, a result achieved by only a small share of assessed institutions. Executive Director Manal Ahmed Al Mannai said the accreditation confirms that its services meet global standards.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/25/11/2026/مركز-إحسان-يحصل-على-اعتماد-دولي-بتميز-استثنائي · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/إحسان-يحصل-على-الاعتماد-الدولي-carf

item.title: Qatar University concludes Islamic family mediation charter conference
item.description:
Qatar University, through its College of Sharia and Islamic Studies and College of Law, concluded on Wednesday the three-day International Conference on the Islamic Charter for Family Mediation. Organised with the Ministry of Social Development and Family and the Supreme Judicial Council, it aims to build a reference framework for family mediation rooted in Islamic jurisprudence and contemporary legislative experience. Dean of the College of Sharia Dr Ibrahim Al Ansari said the conference responds to growing challenges facing families.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/25/11/2026/جامعة-قطر-تختتم-المؤتمر-الدولي-للميثاق-الإسلامي-للوساطة-الأسرية · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/جامعة-قطر-تقود-جهود-إعداد-ميثاق-إسلامي-للوساطة-الأسرية

item.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi cruise missile heading to western Saudi Arabia
item.description:
The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen said early on Thursday that its air defences intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards western Saudi Arabia. Coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki Al Malki said a drone was also intercepted near Jeddah Islamic Port and that a projectile fell on Jazan Port without causing injuries.
Sources: QNA https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/coalition-intercepts-houthi-cruise-missile-over-western-saudi-arabia · Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/26/11/2026/قوات-التحالف-تعلن-اعتراض-وتدمير-صاروخ-كروز-أطلقته-جماعة-الحوثي-باتجاه-المنطقة-الغربية

item.title: Projectile explodes near tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai
item.description:
The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said on Wednesday evening that a tanker reported an explosion from an unknown projectile close by, 50 nautical miles west of Dubai, with no damage or injuries. The incident occurred inside the Gulf near loading routes that had looked relatively safe, at a time when oil flows through Hormuz are running at roughly half their normal rate.
Sources: investingLive https://investinglive.com/commodities/projectile-explodes-near-tanker-50-nautical-miles-off-dubai-as-gulf-shipping-attacks-mount/ · Al Jazeera English (live blog) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/25/iran-war-live-houthis-threaten-saudi-ports-over-coalitions-hodeidah-order?update=5187220

item.title: Budget 2027 Forum: non-oil revenue covers 37% of Saudi spending
item.description:
Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan told the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday that non-oil revenue now covers about 37% of government spending, compared with 16% in earlier years. The forum put available investment opportunities at about $1 trillion over the next eight to ten years. Transport and Logistics Minister Saleh Al-Jasser said new investment commitments in his sector are expected to reach SR45bn in 2026.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345575 · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666540/saudi-arabia/saudi-transport-and-logistics-investments-set-to-hit-sr45-billion-in-2026

item.title: Saudi U-17s beat Haiti to reach knockouts for first time since 1989
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's under-17 team reached the round of 32 of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Doha after beating Haiti 2-1 on Wednesday in their final Group D game. Haiti led in the 28th minute before Abdullah Al-Dosari and Zaid Al-Boury scored in the 54th and 77th minutes. The team finished second on six points behind France, reaching the knockout stage for the first time since winning the title in 1989.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345782 · Sada El Balad (MENA) https://www.elbalad.news/7194517

item.title: Kuwait PM reviews infrastructure and state land survey plans
item.description:
Kuwaiti Prime Minister Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah chaired a meeting at Bayan Palace on Wednesday on developing infrastructure and completing plans to survey and classify state land for future projects. On the same day, Public Works Minister Dr Nora Al-Mashaan met a diplomatic delegation from China, Japan, South Korea, India and Pakistan to discuss infrastructure projects.
Sources: Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54372/kuwait/premier-reviews-infra-development-land-management/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-taps-5-asian-nations-for-expertise/

item.title: Kuwait's Khaitan campaign records 1,340 enforcement actions
item.description:
Kuwait's Interior Ministry carried out a two-day joint field campaign in Khaitan under the supervision of First Deputy Prime Minister and Interior Minister Sheikh Fahad Al-Yousef, resulting in 1,340 enforcement actions. The campaign targeted encroachments on state property, illegal construction and safety, health and labour violations, with the municipality, fire force and food and manpower authorities taking part. Sheikh Fahad said the campaigns will continue until all governorates are covered.
Sources: Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54369/kuwait/major-crackdown-in-khaitan/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/two-day-crackdown-in-kuwaits-khaitan-records-1340-enforcement-actions/

item.title: Warraq fire toll rises to 31 dead and 21 injured
item.description:
The Ministry of Health and Population announced on Wednesday evening the final toll of the petroleum tanker fire on the Ring Road in Warraq, Giza: 31 dead and 21 injured receiving treatment. President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi directed support and care for the injured and victims' families, and the Prime Minister instructed authorities to register those affected for compensation. Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy said the ministry's role will extend to psychological and social support for families.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632738 · Alborsa News https://alborsaanews.com/2026/11/25/2009154 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194918 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194934

item.title: Madbouly: shipping and insuring a barrel of oil exceeds $20
item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly told a news conference on Wednesday that the cost of shipping and insuring a barrel of oil has risen to more than $20, from between $2 and $3 previously. He said Egypt is securing its energy needs through agreements with several countries, and that these pressures affect importing and exporting countries alike.
Sources: Cairo24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535949 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194441

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP54.73 selling as Thursday trading opens
item.description:
The dollar was steady at Banque Misr at the start of trading on Thursday at EGP54.63 buying and EGP54.73 selling, its Wednesday closing level after rising 46 piastres. The euro stood at EGP60.02 selling and sterling at EGP71.80.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194477 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news-banking/details/2026/11/25/3084405 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632388

item.title: Briefing request seeks fee exemption for one phone per Egyptian abroad
item.description:
MP Islam El-Telwany, a member of the House Foreign Relations Committee, submitted a briefing request to the Prime Minister and the Finance Minister on fees for mobile phones brought in by Egyptians living abroad. He called for a permanent exemption for at least one personal phone per expatriate on repeated visits, distinguishing personal phones from devices imported for trade.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084282 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5777754

item.title: Dense morning fog and light rain on northern coasts
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority expects mild daytime weather on Thursday across most areas, hot in southern Upper Egypt and cool at night. Fog will form from 4am to 9am on roads in the north down to Greater Cairo, the Canal cities, central Sinai and northern Upper Egypt, at times dense. The chance of light rain rises to about 30% on the northern coasts, the northern Delta and Halayeb-Shalateen.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/x/7632173 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/102898

item.title: Kushner: biggest Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap expected before Christmas
item.description:
US special envoy Jared Kushner said Russia and Ukraine are preparing a large prisoner exchange with US participation before Christmas on 25 December, which he said would be the biggest since the war began. He said the trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi was mainly devoted to arranging the exchange for humanitarian reasons. He also said Europe had bought more than $250bn of Russian fossil fuels during the war.
Sources: Masrawy (agencies) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/26/3084724 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194913

item.title: Ukraine strikes Savasleyka base, hitting five Russian aircraft
item.description:
Ukraine's General Staff said on Wednesday its forces struck the Savasleyka airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow, hitting three MiG-31 jets used to fire hypersonic missiles and two Su-34 fighter-bombers. It said the aircraft would be unable to fly for some time and that the extent of the damage was being assessed. Moscow did not immediately comment.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/ukraine-attacks-russian-military-base-says-five-planes-struck · Ukrinform https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188463-ukrainian-defense-forces-strike-savasleyka-airfield-in-russia.html

item.title: Kim calls for deploying tactical nuclear weapons across multiple domains
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for focusing on deploying tactical nuclear weapons "across multiple domains for different missions", state news agency KCNA said on Thursday. Inspecting nuclear material production and weapons research facilities, he said the country's nuclear material production capacity was being systematically expanded and that its status as a nuclear state was "absolutely inviolable".
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/kim-jong-un-says-north-korea-should-widen-deployment-of-tactical-nukes · Masrawy (agencies) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/26/3084713

item.title: US-led consortium agrees to buy Lukoil's international assets
item.description:
A consortium led by US firm Eldridge announced on Wednesday a final agreement to acquire Lukoil International, the global portfolio of sanctioned Russian group Lukoil, through a securities swap. The group includes the US International Development Finance Corporation, UAE-based Catena Investment Holding and Xtellus Partners. The assets produce about 350,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day in 11 countries and include three refineries in Bulgaria, the Netherlands and Romania.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345640 · The National https://thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/25/todd-boehly-lukoil

item.title: Netanyahu trial judges recommend dropping bribery charge
item.description:
Judges at the Tel Aviv District Court on Wednesday recommended that Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara drop the bribery charge in Case 4000 against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and re-examine Case 2000. Netanyahu called for the trial to end immediately, while his rival Gadi Eisenkot seeks to form a government after the 27 October elections.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/netanyahu-says-corruption-trial-must-end-as-court-suggests-dropping-case · i24NEWS https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/israel/politics/artc-judges-in-netanyahu-trial-to-ag-we-recommend-dropping-case-4000-re-examining-case-2000
